description: This Java test class verifies the immutability, equality, and placeholder resolution behavior of the ImmutablePlaceholderResolver class in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains unit tests that check resolver operations based on different input types such as maps, ThingId, and TopicPath, and asserts immutability and equality properties.

classes.name: ImmutablePlaceholderResolverTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ImmutablePlaceholderResolver, verifying immutability, equality, and placeholder resolution for different input scenarios.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutablePlaceholderResolver is immutable, allowing certain reasons for fields not being modified.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutablePlaceholderResolver's equals and hashCode methods function correctly.

methods.name: testPlaceholderResolvementBasedOnMap
methods.description: Tests resolution of placeholders based on a Map input.

methods.name: testPlaceholderResolvementBasedOnThingId
methods.description: Tests placeholder resolution based on a ThingId object.

methods.name: testPlaceholderResolvementBasedOnTopic
methods.description: Tests placeholder resolution based on a TopicPath object.
